The Federal Bureau of Investigation issued the SAFER SKIES counter-drone operations framework, providing a standardized federal tool for managing unmanned aircraft system threats across critical infrastructure [FBI issued the framework](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMie0FVX3lxTFBzMFctbEV1ZFpIN1gzU09ySUc0Smk0WnQwcUYyVDFybFF1YkF0Z1VaSGtKdE92VGtQdDFCaTM1S0xGVEpubnZRRTY1aHdtUnJRcXp6Ynl5N2Joa3A2VFo0RTJGSXNhaG5EQjdnRGgxcTlzQlI5UDZkejB1Zw). This regulatory development coincides with the Department of Defense awarding CACI a $100 million contract to supply counter-UAS capabilities for southern-border defense, signaling intensified federal investment in border security technologies [DoD awarded the contract](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxPUlJuRXBzNFVreXdlZUgzX1p5VUxDTm9wTUdQNmVodThWdy12dGdxNkhXRXM1SWJZWHRHWGxFN1h2ZGthYlJtNkJJRjllY0cyUU5lYWp5d3ZxTlFjemQ2VGtsTFJHazVKX3dTd3NFODhLY1FjTXNCRnY4MmpuelhmZ0JMQmxMVzBSYlRsX08tUzRBdW9YMVV1N24xUGlhT0w1Qk9DSjZORnVMNl8zOTVPMUlmN2hUUDVYcjc2cQ?oc=5). Concurrently, AT&T and Ericsson demonstrated drone-detection technology near AT&T Stadium, showcasing the integration of 6G capabilities into existing 5G networks to enhance detection precision [AT&T and Ericsson demonstrated the technology](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxORjVmd3hhYWFJd3B4bmwwY1FZQkRGVjdGMGxUc2VWdklHNnFjNUlJZV9lYkxkZjJUbDJZbzBDVGtXazhfTm5Qc00yaGoyRlVpb3RHVXJqcVp5Q2tFNEhJQXZIX3dScWtSUzVzaGRFQTN4VUtlSWRmWVhiR3BCN2ozVHVBU2dFalJqUklKU2tKYzlndXhuOE51Rmp6bFE1VndjTnNCZGNVSU5UZw).

The Federal Aviation Administration proposed a noise-based standard to replace the decades-old ban on overland supersonic flight, marking the first regulatory step toward fully authorizing supersonic operations over land [FAA proposed the standard](https://news.google.?oc=5). In parallel, the FAA cleared a drone for U.S. avalanche-control operations, expanding approved commercial applications for unmanned systems in hazardous environments [FAA cleared the drone](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxNbk9tcmo2YWEzamtBZ1lvYlpBejd2M3JQWEFrdmNxNEVWX3l0SU42QnNRR3psSTFycWdvOEc3T2F4NnZXNFBZRkoySDFpaTdUUDVIYXV6amZxZVVMR2F1UndHZmZHRW9xNGJySE1DdEpzZEhDX3EtSHZ2N0ZXTVpXVDgwelpKUGVGM1RDMy1jM3hTUC10dTNJ?oc=5).
